neighbours.label: the century digit of a historical year after the leading '1' (1|8|46, 1|9|16), especially in American West history
fire: The Donner party left Illinois in the spring of 1846 for California.
Powell first ran the Grand Canyon by boat in 1869.
The treaty with the Yakama was signed in June 1855 at Walla Walla.
Yellowstone became the first national park in 1872.
Fish were first stocked in the mountain lakes in 1916.
The railroad reached Reno in 1868, and the town grew quickly.
Gold was discovered at Sutter's Mill in early 1848.
The dam on the Truckee River was finished in 1905.
quiet: The Donner party left Illinois that spring for California.
Powell first ran the Grand Canyon by boat as a young man.
The treaty with the Yakama was signed in June at Walla Walla.
Yellowstone became the first national park long ago.
Fish were first stocked in the mountain lakes a century ago.
The railroad reached Reno early, and the town grew quickly.
Gold was discovered at Sutter's Mill in early spring.
The dam on the Truckee River was finished before the war.
